slots.name: prompt
slots.about: the sentence to put into words

slots.name: words
slots.about: copied into state: id (1 up, the bank order, so a shuffle: the engine has no random), word, right (its place in the answer, 1 up), at (0, in the bank)

slots.name: tries
slots.about: wrong checks allowed before the order is shown

slots.name: answer_empty
slots.about: the faint line in the answer box before any tile is placed

slots.name: tries_line
slots.about: the line under the answer; may read left (tries left) and max_tries

slots.name: wrong_text
slots.about: the line after a wrong check; the tiles out of place are marked

slots.name: key_text
slots.about: the heading over the right order once the tries run out

slots.name: done_line
slots.about: the line once solved or out of tries; may read solved, used (wrong checks), hints and max_tries

slots.name: place
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: a tap on a bank tile puts it at the end of the answer

slots.name: back
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: takes the last tile back to the bank

slots.name: check
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: checks a full answer

slots.name: hint
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: keeps the right start, sends the rest back and places the next right tile

slots.name: again
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: every tile back, tries and hints cleared

empty.shows: empty_note only; no answer box, no bank, no buttons

attention.shows: the tiles out of place in the destructive colour with a cross, and wrong_note, until the next tile moves

fallback.shows: the right order under key_text, the result line and the again button

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops shrink, smooth, swap and rise
accessibility.not_colour_alone: a tile out of place carries a cross, a solved answer a check, and both come with a line
